self_deprecating.instructions: Does the speaker make fun of themselves?

criteria.true: the speaker mocks their own looks, height, age, career, or competence
criteria.false: the speaker is not the target of the humor

absurd_escalation.instructions: Does the joke start from a normal premise and push it to an absurd extreme?

criteria.true: an ordinary setup escalates into something implausible or ridiculous
criteria.false: the joke stays within plausible territory

mock_outrage.instructions: Does the speaker overreact with exaggerated outrage over something small?

criteria.true: a trivial thing gets a wildly oversized, indignant reaction

undercuts_itself.instructions: Does the speaker comment on or deflate their own joke?

criteria.true: the narrator reacts to the joke itself, admits it is weak, or breaks the bit
criteria.false: the joke is delivered straight with no comment on itself

silly_tangent.instructions: Does the joke veer into an oddly specific non sequitur?

criteria.true: an unexpected tangent with strange, specific detail
criteria.false: the joke stays on topic with no tangent

overcommits.instructions: Does the joke keep going past its natural stopping point?

criteria.true: the bit continues beyond where a typical joke would end, getting sillier
criteria.false: the joke ends at its natural punchline

silly_button.instructions: Does the joke end with a separate goofy closing line after its main punchline?

criteria.true: a separate short closing line comes after the main punchline
criteria.false: the joke ends on the main punchline with no separate closing line

conan_fit.instructions: How well does this joke fit a Conan O'Brien-style late-night monologue?

host_style.instructions: Which comedic style does this joke most resemble?

criteria.deadpan_political: dry topical commentary with a political edge
criteria.warm_observational: gentle everyday observation with no edge
criteria.pun_dad: wordplay or a pun with a groan-worthy payoff
